title: Disorders of thrombosis and hemostasis
summary: Thrombotic or coagulation disorder with complications requiring at least three hospitalizations within 12-month period, each lasting ≥48 hours and at least 30 days apart.

children.criterion: Disorder of thrombosis or hemostasis (hemophilia, von Willebrand disease, recurrent thromboembolism, etc.)
Three hospitalizations within 12-month period for complications of the disorder (bleeding episodes, thrombotic events), each lasting ≥48 hours, at least 30 days apart
